convert_muse_to_amused_pipeline: run the conversion script to transform a Muse model into a diffusers AmusedPipeline and save it
convert_muse_256_model: run the conversion script with the model_256 flag to convert a 256x256 Muse model
make_transformer_from_muse: create a UVit2DModel transformer by converting state dict weights from a Muse MaskGiTUViT model
make_vqvae_from_muse: create a diffusers VQModel by converting state dict weights from a Muse VQGANModel
convert_vae_block_state_dict: remap VAE block state dict keys from Muse naming convention to diffusers naming convention
